# Contentful Provider

Manage content models, Entries, and settings in existing Contentful spaces. You can also manage organization resources such as teams and App Definitions, and credentials for your account.

## Authentication

Supply a [Content Management API access token](https://www.contentful.com/developers/docs/references/authentication/#the-content-management-api) through `access_token` or `CONTENTFUL_MANAGEMENT_ACCESS_TOKEN`. Use a token with permission to manage the objects in your configuration.

To make requests as an installed app, use its app access token. You can obtain one in Terraform by [signing a JWT](ephemeral-resources/app_jwt) and [exchanging it for an app access token](ephemeral-resources/app_access_token).

## Configuration

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    contentful = {
      source = "cysp/contentful"
    }
  }
}

provider "contentful" {}
```

## Common tasks

- **Work with existing content.** Use [data sources](guides/existing-configuration) to reference objects managed elsewhere. To bring Entries, Content Types, or Locales under Terraform management, [discover and import them](guides/resource-discovery). Managed changes to [Entries](resources/entry) publish content. Managed changes to [Content Types](resources/content_type) activate the content model.
- **Clone an environment.** [Wait for the copy to become ready](resources/environment#environment-readiness) before pointing an alias at it. The [timeouts guide](guides/operation-timeouts) covers slow copies and interrupted writes.
- **Configure content preview.** Set [preview URLs](resources/preview_environment) for Content Types and [custom preview tokens](resources/live_preview_variables) for an environment.
- **Manage access.** Assign [roles](resources/role) to [teams](resources/team) through [space memberships](resources/team_space_membership). Use [Delivery API keys](resources/delivery_api_key) for applications that read published content.
- **Install an app.** Use an [App Definition](resources/app_definition) you manage or look up a [Marketplace App Definition](data-sources/marketplace_app_definition), then [install it in an environment](resources/app_installation).
- **Adopt or rotate credentials.** Check [which secrets Contentful returns on import](guides/secrets-and-state) before applying a configuration that could replace an existing secret.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `access_token` (String, Sensitive) Content Management API access token. Defaults to `CONTENTFUL_MANAGEMENT_ACCESS_TOKEN` when omitted or null. An explicit empty string overrides the environment variable and fails validation. The token must be known at provider configuration.
- `url` (String) Content Management API base URL. Defaults to `CONTENTFUL_URL` when omitted or null. An empty resolved URL selects the public Contentful Management API at `https://api.contentful.com`. Use the final endpoint directly because the provider rejects redirects on writes.
